A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OptimusVLA work and contain 17 readable pages, including supplementary Sections A–E. Their text, equations, eight figures, and nine tables support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulation and real-world robot evaluations, component ablations, and efficiency measurements in Section 4 and the supplementary material.

after.justification: v2 retains these original simulation, real-world, ablation, and efficiency results, including the supplementary evaluations.

M1.justification: GPM retrieval and adaptive sampling, LCM's consistency mechanism, and the three-stage training procedure are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices B–C.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same LIBERO suites, CALVIN tasks, 16 RoboTwin 2.0 Hard tasks, and eight real-world manipulation tasks. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the tables and figures. For example, Tables 3 and 7 retain RDT, ACT, DP, DP3, π0, and π0.5; their changed citation numbers identify the same works.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Appendices C–D retain the same splits, metrics, training budgets, and evaluation procedures. CALVIN's ABC-to-D split, 500-rollout simulation evaluations, and 100 rollouts per RoboTwin task remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The GPM/LCM and memory-size ablations in Tables 4–5, efficiency analyses in Figures 4–5, and qualitative cases in Figures 6–8 are unchanged. No robustness or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged across the main paper and appendices. There are no added or revised seed counts, repeated-run summaries, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. Examples include 98.6% on LIBERO (Table 1), 4.45 on CALVIN (Table 2), and RoboTwin averages of 38% for the eight displayed tasks (Table 3) and 30% across 16 tasks (Table 7).

T1.justification: The flow-matching definitions, prior construction, adaptive sampling formulas, and training objectives in Equations 1–33 are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same dual-memory contributions, efficiency and robustness claims, and headline results. The citation substitutions do not alter these claims.

C2.justification: The explanations of experimental outcomes remain identical. Appendix A retains the limitations concerning memory-bank coverage and fixed-length local context, along with the same proposed future directions.

D1.justification: Hardware, model size, hyperparameters, training details, FAISS retrieval, caching, and cold-start training disclosures are unchanged. The project URL and supplementary-video access reference are also retained.

R1.justification: Five cited works are removed and six added within otherwise unchanged discussion. The VLA survey is replaced by EnergyAction, PUMA by TINA, and three face/media-manipulation references by EmoCaps and three person/video-analysis works. These are localized citation substitutions without a substantive rewrite of research positioning.

P1.justification: The abstract corrects 'umber' to 'number'; citation numbering and the arXiv version/date stamp are updated. The remaining prose, section order, terminology, and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Bibliography edits cause limited reflow on PDF pages 9–11, including moving the final reference into page 11's right column. Figures and tables retain their designs and placement, with only citation-number changes in some tables and captions.

improvement.justification: The typo correction provides a small editorial benefit, while the citation substitutions add no substantive discussion or evidence. The method, experimental support, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged throughout both PDFs, yielding no meaningful net difference in overall quality.
